os/aiueos/scripts/build-os-release-bundl.reason: Bundle driver: one signed release per distributions/*/distribution.json with slug-named flat assets, then the static catalog. Signing is the caller's operation; production keys stay offline.

os/aiueos/scripts/make-release-catalog.p.reason: Static release catalog generator for the downloadable OS bundle (AWAI-92): verifies each receipt signature and every artifact digest from the signed release before writing release-catalog.json and SHA256SUMS. It composes metadata from the existing signed release; it adds no authority and no signing rule.

deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (dep io.nayuki/qrcodegen, dep com.dylibso.chicory/wasm, dep com.dylibso.chicory/runtime, dep io.github.cognitect-labs/test-runner (in :test), :main-opts (in :test), :exec-fn (in :test), dep io.github.cognitect-labs/test-runner (in :ci), :main-opts (in :ci), alias :vmm-gate, alias :security-adoption, dep io.github.cognitect-labs/test-runner (in :test-fleet), :main-opts (in :test-fleet), alias :tcb-check, alias :cloud-live, alias :phone-bind, alias :session, alias :compositor, alias :kami-presenter, alias :bare-metal, alias :attest, alias :reproduce, alias :build, alias :hvt, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package. (sha256 refreshed 2026-10-27: the monorepo deps sync changed the bytes again without updating this record; the recorded digest is now the actual bytes of this tree.)

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

os/aiueos/scripts/build-release-image.sh.reason: Pass AIUEOS_DISTRIBUTION_JSON through to make-release-image.py build so the canonical build can bind a distribution descriptor into the receipt.

os/aiueos/scripts/make-release-image.py.reason: Bind an aiueos.distribution.v1 descriptor into the signed build receipt (--distribution-json) so a signed release names its distribution. The change is the load_distribution helper, the new build flag and the receipt's distribution field; the rest is the imported source.

os/aiueos/scripts/sign-release-image.py.reason: Name the signature after the receipt it signs (receipt stem + .sig) so distribution-named receipts get matching signature names. The default receipt name keeps the previous aiueos-x86_64-build-receipt.sig output.
